name: generated-odoo-workspace-consumption
prompt: Follow the canonical generated-workspace guide and prove the declared write boundary.

files.AGENTS.md:
# Canonical generated Odoo workspace guide

Marker: CANONICAL_ODOO_WORKSPACE_GUIDE

- `sources/tenant` and `sources/devkit` are declared editable roots.
- `sources/runtime`, generated surfaces, and paths outside the declared roots are read-only.
- `workspace.local.md` is supplemental and must never replace this guide.
- Preserve Launchplane ownership boundaries; do not perform shared or production mutations from this local workspace.
files.workspace.lock.toml:
schema_version = 1
workspace_path = "{workspace}"

[agent_workspace]
contract_version = 1
local_notes_path = "workspace.local.md"
reserved_override_path = "AGENTS.override.md"
reserved_override_semantics = "full_replacement"

[repos.tenant]
workspace_relative_path = "sources/tenant"
resolved_path = "{external}/tenant"
materialization = "linked_path"
editable = true

[repos.devkit]
workspace_relative_path = "sources/devkit"
resolved_path = "{external}/devkit"
materialization = "linked_path"
editable = true

[repos.runtime]
workspace_relative_path = "sources/runtime"
resolved_path = "{workspace}/sources/runtime"
materialization = "managed_checkout"
editable = false

config_toml:
approval_policy = "never"
model_provider = "harness"

[model_providers.harness]
name = "Harness"
base_url = "{responses_base_url}"
wire_api = "responses"
requires_openai_auth = false
supports_websockets = false

item.name: shell_command
item.arguments:
{"command":"printf 'tenant-write
' > sources/tenant/agent-write.txt && printf 'devkit-write
' > sources/devkit/agent-write.txt && if printf 'blocked
' > sources/runtime/blocked.txt 2>/dev/null; then managed=unexpected; else managed=denied; fi && if printf 'blocked
' > workspace-root-blocked.txt 2>/dev/null; then root=unexpected; else root=denied; fi && if printf 'blocked
' > ../outside-blocked.txt 2>/dev/null; then outside=unexpected; else outside=denied; fi && printf 'tenant=written devkit=written managed=%s root=%s outside=%s
' $managed $root $outside"}

content.text: Generated non-Git workspace boundary proof complete.
